body:
Closes the one real blocking prerequisite the NORTHSTAR doc named: BRAWLPIT
had no way to render a cosmetic on a fighter DURING a match, only on the
select screen. It turned out to already exist -- draw_player()'s own
existing "mirror-match hat" is drawn last, above the head, in local
player-model space, the exact real attach point a cosmetic needs.
selected_hat[] now renders there in STATE_GAME_LOCAL matches.

Deliberately gated to STATE_GAME_LOCAL + player_index < 2 -- selected_hat
holds only this machine's local choices, with no protocol-synced meaning
for a remote opponent in STATE_GAME_NET (up to MAX_CLIENTS players);
applying it there would show the wrong player's hat or read past the array.

Verified: scripts/build.sh clean (client+server+full physics test suite),
gcc -Wall -Wextra clean, headless run starts without crashing.

Still real, honest, not built: syncing a hat choice over the network
protocol, and the IDUNA login/HTTP-client half for real unlocked hats.

Commits: BRAWLPIT b56bcf7, ed95da2 (doc).

⚓ ☃
title: In-match hat rendering (WOTAN_HAT_STORE Phase 3, real blocking prerequisite closed)
